label: UniFi AI Port
description: UniFi AI Port (UP-AI-Port) - an inline appliance that adds AI detection to an existing camera: one GbE RJ45 in with PoE passthrough to the camera it sits in front of.
notes: Vendor figures from Ubiquiti techspecs: (1) GbE RJ45 port; PoE passthrough is conditional on what the port is fed - PoE+ input is required for 12.95 W of PoE output, and PoE++ input for PoE+ output. Modelled with a single eth0, poeIn 12.95 W, and both poe-pd and poe-pse capabilities because it is simultaneously powered and powering.
